title: The One Who Lurks
text: Then, it’s time to take action.
“So, Yuki-chan, let’s check out the forest and then head back to the village.”
“Understood! I’ll go search now!”
Father and Older Sister went toward the cave, while Yuki-chan and I went to the forest to look for anything edible.
At first glance, the forest didn’t seem too deep.
I could see the other side through the gaps between the trees.
“Is there anything edible here?”
With that thought, I looked up together with Yuki-chan.
At that moment, I heard a rustling sound from the bushes.
Was something hiding there?
“Is it a monster?”
Just as I was about to ready my spear, something emerged from the bushes as if fleeing.
What is that?
A weasel, composed of something that looked like a pale blue shimmer or heat haze?
It might be a ghost-type monster.
I immediately changed my weapon to the Soul Eater Spear.
However, the pale blue weasel didn’t seem to react.
The monster stopped briefly and glanced back at us.
Then, the weasel changed its form.
In an instant, it took on the appearance of a tanuki.
It’s a little bigger than usual.
This one has a physical form.
I feel like I can see a shadow of a person within the haze.
Is it different from a ghost-type monster?
As I considered whether to chase after it and take it down, the tanuki had already turned its back and started running.
And as it moved, it multiplied into several more along with the heat haze.
If it’s a monster, I should just annihilate it!
“Aiming—”
But before I could throw my spear, the weasels, which had transformed further as they ran, all leapt into the sea and disappeared completely.
“What was that?”
Chasing after fleeing prey was one option, but they didn’t look like suitable food, so ignoring them seemed fine.
If they appeared again, I could just take them down then.
I resumed searching for any edible fruit in the forest and then went with Yuki-chan to fetch Filolial-sama and the slaves.
After that, the monster didn’t appear again.
The slaves and Filolial-samas enjoyed a swim at Older Sister’s hidden island before returning to the castle.
The next day, around noon.
A slightly tired-looking Assistant returned, accompanied by Ren and Rival.
“We’re back.”
“Welcome back.”
During a break in the search for Filo-tan, Father and I greeted them.
“How did it go?”
“Yeah, Father was really strong. I thought I’d gotten pretty strong myself, but I still don’t think I can beat him. But… why does he have power similar to Gaelion?”
“Na… no!”
Rival was crying out as if worried about Assistant.
No matter how I looked at it, didn’t Assistant just win by using Rival’s abilities?
“Isn’t it normal for a parent and child to be similar?”
“Hmm… I was able to beat the Father in my memories, though…”
That is undoubtedly true. After all, he’s weak enough to lose to Ren, whose enhancement methods are half-baked. He doesn’t even come close to Rival’s level now.
Moreover, Assistant has leveled up quite a bit, so it should have been an easy win. The fact that she still couldn’t win makes it clear that she was definitely borrowing Rival’s power.
“Memory and reality are different things. Something that looks easy can be difficult when you actually try it.”
“Yeah. Father was really strong after all. The Sword Hero said the same thing.”

Assistant nodded there. It’s probably not just my imagination that she looks proud of having such a strong father. However, Assistant slightly lowered her head so that her bangs cast a shadow over her eyes and grinned.
“When I get even stronger, I’ll challenge him again. Next time, I’ll surpass Father.”
Fufufufufu… she’s giving an unsettling grin. On the other hand, Rival looks like he’s trembling at that sight. Father and Ren looked at Assistant and Rival with a somewhat exasperated expression.
“Good work, Ren.”
“Ah, it’s no big deal. I’m just leveling up, studying, and training to prepare for the waves anyway. It was a good change of pace.”
“That’s good to hear.”
“How’s it going on your end?”
“Hm? Ah… we haven’t found anything yet. But I don’t plan to give up.”
“No, that’s not what I meant.”
Ren glanced back and forth between Father and me.
“We haven’t found Filo-tan’s egg.”
“Ah, yeah, I know about Motoyasu. I also asked Naofumi. But Naofumi, how’s Sadeena doing?”
Father was about to open his mouth to respond, with a slight cough.
“Oh my, Wyndia-chan, are you back?”
Older Sister came over with the slaves.
“Welcome back, Ren-chan.”
“Ah, yeah.”
Ren pointed at Older Sister and then looked at Father. Father nodded.
“Her cold has gotten better, and Sadeena is back to full strength.”
“I see. That’s good to hear.”
“Yeah.”
“Well, I should get back to work. I’ll be heading on an expedition to the Northfera Great Forest soon,” Ren said while stretching.
“I need to make preparations. I’ll also be strengthening the forces to prepare for the Four Guardian Beasts and the waves.”
“Yeah, we need to get ready in advance… You’ll be raising the Filolials too, right?”
“It’s for Motoyasu, after all.”
“I’ve secured Luna-chan’s egg!”
Father said he wanted to redo the experiment. Ah, I’ll get to reunite with that adorable Luna-chan. But unfortunately, Keel isn’t here, is he? Would Mole be an acceptable substitute?
“Nano?”
At that moment, Rival sniffed the air and transformed into his dragon form. Then, as if tracing the scent, he followed Father and then Older Sister.
“Na… nano…?”
“Oh? What’s wrong?”
Older Sister sat down to meet Rival’s gaze and extended her hand to pet him. However, Rival ignored her hand and kept sniffing. Eventually, Rival’s eyes widened…
“Nanooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!”
He placed both hands on his cheeks and screamed. It was like a pose straight out of a painting.
“Gaelion… wants to loop… nano…”
Then he collapsed.
“Gaelion!?”
“Gaelion-chan!?”
“Wh-what happened?”
“What’s wrong?”
Older Sister lifted the collapsed Rival, but he remained unconscious. What a strange dragon he is.
“For now, something might have happened to Gaelion-chan, so should we take him to Rat?”
“Got it! I’ll take him right away!”
Ren took Rival and Assistant and teleported away using the portal.
“What… exactly happened?”
“Maybe the alcohol I was drinking was too strong? I had some really good stuff yesterday.”
“Gaelion-chan is a dragon, so he’s supposed to be strong against alcohol…”
“Did Rival develop some strange disease? If so, serves him right.”
“Indeed.”
“Waaaah!”
The Filolials laughed together cheerfully. I’m starting to enjoy this too.
“Um… everyone, it’s not okay to laugh at someone being sick, you know?”

With Father’s glare, the Filolials stopped laughing. I suppose I should stop here too. By the way, Rival regained consciousness the next day, and the Doctor confirmed he wasn’t sick—on the contrary, he was in excellent health. They analyzed it as something psychological, but when they asked, he refused to talk. What could possibly be making him so emotionally unstable?
